title: Preview card
description: A link with a visual preview on hover or keyboard focus: dismissible with Escape, hoverable, never in the Tab order, and documented as a visual extra only.
docs: Akso UI Preview card. The preview is a visual extra: keep everything it shows on the linked page. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md
